nodes.title: SG-8.4.1 Rewrite repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md is still the 71-line README-only draft with 13 UNKNOWN placeholders, 'hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index' and 'Bidirectional links'. Desired behavior: it names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go (backend) and its module table lists only game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, When the contextStack tests run, Then every STACK_TERMS entry and Go are present and no UNKNOWN or stale text remains
- Given the module table, When contextPaths tests run, Then exactly the four required paths are listed and all exist on disk


## Scope
- In scope: Rewrite of context.md content: Stack, Modules, remove stale sections
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: gameplay or source changes
- Out of scope: SG-8.4.2 to SG-8.4.5
- Preserve: Existing docsCheck and contextDoc helper contracts
- Preserve: Existing tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test deleted or skipped
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- backend/ (Go) out of scope
- No source file over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.body:

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists only the real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: the table lists README.md and .gitignore only. Desired behavior: rows for the four real paths, each existing at repo root. Expected result: contextPaths tests pass. Why: readers find real modules.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, When contextModulePaths runs, Then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/
- Given those paths, When missingPaths checks them against the repo root, Then it returns []


## Scope
- In scope: context.md Modules table, Entry points and Workflows tables with real paths
- Out of scope: Stack section
- Preserve: contextModulePaths contract


## Technical constraints
- backend/ (Go) listed as out of scope
- game/src never imports from game/frontend


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- contextPaths tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
